description: Free sample: https://apexfaucet.xyz/tx-check ($0.001). Check one unsigned Base or Solana transaction and return SAFE or RISKY. Base: simulation, unlimited approval, approval-for-all, a hidden token move, and one exit check. Solana: simulation, a token drain, a delegate approval, and a rug mint. Nothing is signed or broadcast. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Base or USDC on Solana only). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

data.description: Base 0x calldata, required unless raw is set

from.description: Base sender (0x...), or the Solana signer when signer is omitted

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

raw.description: Base serialized unsigned transaction, or the Solana transaction when tx is omitted

to.description: Base contract (0x...), required unless raw is set

tx.description: unsigned Solana transaction, base64 or base58

name: tx_check
title: Tx check
